notes: 待推送判据改为内容级：只有实际内容变了才提示推送。DSH 重写 cordis.patch.yml、会话 projcache / session-index 造成的 mtime 假变更不再误报；引入内容指纹基线 + pendingKeys 防止洗白；db/sqlite ≤64MB 走全量 hash，避免同尺寸原地更新漏检；autoPush 与退出推送判据同步享受新口径。隔离审查两轮无阻断项，selftest 无新增失败。
notesEn: Content-level pending detection: only prompt to push when content actually changed. mtime-only churn from DSH rewriting cordis.patch.yml, session projcache / session-index no longer produces false positives; a content-fingerprint baseline plus pendingKeys prevents whitewashing; db/sqlite files up to 64MB use full hashing to catch same-size in-place updates; autoPush and close-time push criteria share the same new rule. Two rounds of isolated review found no blocking issues and selftest had no new failures.
